supply.name: Supply room
supply.locked: Supply room. The lock has iced over. The key comes up with tomorrow's supplies.

airlockInner.name: Airlock
airlockInner.locked: The airlock door is sealed for the night. Vance's tape is still on the frame.

airlockSide.name: Airlock
airlockSide.locked: The airlock door won't give. Something has frozen in the seal.

airlockOuter.name: Outer door
airlockOuter.locked: The outer door is frozen into its frame. Minus thirty out there, and nothing out there needs you tonight.

bunkRoom.name: Vance's room
bunkRoom.locked: Vance's room, taped shut from this side. Dispatch says it stays sealed for the inquiry.
bunkRoom.taped: Taped shut from this side, three layers deep. Hold USE to cut through.

west.name: West door
west.locked: Frozen into its frame. Minus thirty out there, and nothing worth going out for.
